results.title: Roohi
results.overview: In a fictional North Indian town, two boys Bhaura and Kattanni are stuck in a forest with Roohi. But there’s an insidious spirit following them with feet turned backwards.

results.title: Gehraiyaan
results.overview: Alisha Khanna, 30, ambitious, now finds herself at crossroads in life. Her six year long relationship has grown monotonous, her career seems to be going nowhere. But just when she had begun to accept this reality as unchangeable, her life is usurped by the arrival of her cousin, Tia and her fiancé, Zain, with whom she bonds over a troubled past and a common wish to break from its confines.

results.title: Main Krishna Hoon
results.overview: In answer to an orphan boy's prayers, the divine Lord Krishna comes to Earth, befriends the boy, and helps him find a loving family.

results.title: Deewane Huye Paagal
results.overview: A man embarks on journey to find his love in Dubai, only to learn she has different suitors and admirers.

results.title: Made In China
results.overview: A struggling Gujarati businessman ventures into the world of China where he gets a brilliant business idea that could change his life forever.

results.title: Ghayal
results.overview: Ajay is framed by Balwant Rai for his brother's murder and sent to prison. Later, he befriends three convicts and sets out to seek revenge against Balwant Rai.

results.title: Nil Battey Sannata
results.overview: Behind the magnificent Taj Mahal lies a cluster of dingy homes where Chanda (35), a domestic help, lives with her 14-year-old daughter Appu. Chanda aspires and dreams that her daughter will study and embrace a better fate. When Appu tells her she wants to quit school and become a maid like her, Chanda takes a strong decision: she will herself go back to school, and even join the class of her daughter.

results.title: Dhol
results.overview: Pankaj , Gautam, Sameer and Martand are roommates in Pune who are bound together by their ambition to make it big in life with the least effort possible. Each one tries his hand at finding a shortcut to success but ends up being in even deeper trouble. Things get worse when the four decide to take a loan at high interest which they are unable to pay back. They believe that the only way to get rich without working hard is to marry the wealthy girl in their neighborhood and each of the four friends embark on their individual plans to woo her.

results.title: Shuddh Desi Romance
results.overview: A journey of three restless young people who junk the society's syllabus for finding love and decide to follow their heart.
1920, India. After forsaking his family and religion, a husband finds his wife is possessed by a spirit.

results.title: Dishoom
results.overview: When India's top cricketer is kidnapped in the Middle East, a loose cannon and a rookie cop are tasked with finding him before the high-stakes match with Pakistan.

results.title: Bombay Velvet
results.overview: An ordinary man, who goes against all odds to forge his own destiny and become a star in the glittering sky of 'Bombay,' thriving on jazz and violence.

results.title: Hisss
results.overview: After being diagnosed with brain cancer, a desperate American man kidnaps the reptilian lover of the snake goddess in hopes of gaining immortality.

results.title: Fukrey Returns
results.overview: A year after the first movie, the four friends are enjoying their lives to the fullest, get in trouble once again with Bholi, who is released from prison earlier than expected and is broke.

results.title: Housefull 3
results.overview: A father doesn't want his three daughters to get married. Now, it's up to three men to try to and convince the father that they're a good fit for his daughters.

results.title: Blackmail
results.overview: When Dev finds about his wife's affair, he starts blackmailing her and her lover but the blackmail game backfires on him.

results.title: Phantom
results.overview: Phantom is an action thriller that unfolds across various countries around the world. The plot revolves around protagonist Daniyal, whose journey to seek justice takes him from India to Europe, America and the volatile Middle East. However, he finds out that in a mission like this, there is always a price to pay, in this case, a very personal price.

results.title: Badlapur
results.overview: After his wife and son are killed, a young man finds out the man behind the murder and fights against him, along committing some big mistakes.

results.title: Deewana Mastana
results.overview: Neha, a psychiatrist, is pursued by both Raja and Bunnu. While Raja is a small-time crook pretending to be an NRI, Bunnu is her patient. The two try to outsmart each other to win Neha's heart.

results.title: ABCD
results.overview: When a capable dancer is provoked by the evil design of his employer, naturally he will be out to prove his mettle.
